rejection.code_malformed: "{field}" is not a valid code. Use letters, digits, dots, dashes or underscores.
rejection.date_malformed: {field} is not a date. Use the form YYYY-MM-DD.
rejection.text_requires_both_languages: {field} is needed in both English and Arabic.
rejection.metadata_entry_too_long: The metadata entry "{key}" is too long.
rejection.document_reference_malformed: That is not a valid document reference.
rejection.plan_retired: This plan has been retired, so it can no longer be changed or applied.
rejection.plan_has_no_published_version: This plan has no published version, so there is nothing to apply.
rejection.plan_version_not_draft: A published version never changes. Draft the next one instead.
rejection.plan_version_not_published: This version has not been published.
rejection.plan_version_has_no_tasks: A version with no tasks would produce onboardings that finish the moment they begin.
rejection.plan_version_number_out_of_range: That is not a valid version number.
rejection.task_kind_unknown: That is not a kind of task this product understands.
rejection.task_sequence_out_of_range: That is not a valid position in the checklist.
rejection.task_cannot_depend_on_itself: A task cannot wait for itself.
rejection.document_task_needs_a_type: A document task must say which document it is asking for.
rejection.document_task_needs_a_reference: Completing a document task needs the reference of the document that was filed.
rejection.owner_kind_unknown: That is not a kind of owner a task can have.
rejection.owner_reference_required: This kind of owner has to name who or which unit the task belongs to.
rejection.role_owner_needs_a_role: A role queue has to name the role.
rejection.role_owner_takes_no_reference: A role queue belongs to whoever holds the role, not to one person.
rejection.resolved_owner_takes_no_reference: The joiner and their manager are worked out for each onboarding, so no reference is needed here.
rejection.due_anchor_unknown: That is not a date this product can measure a deadline from.
rejection.due_offset_out_of_range: That is further from the anchor date than a deadline can sensibly be.
rejection.onboarding_transition_not_permitted: An onboarding cannot move from {from} to {to}.
rejection.onboarding_already_in_state: This onboarding is already at that stage.
rejection.onboarding_already_planned: This onboarding already has a plan. A checklist cannot be replaced once it has been given.
rejection.onboarding_concluded: This onboarding has finished, so nothing further can be recorded against it.
rejection.required_tasks_outstanding: A required task is neither done nor waived, so this onboarding is not complete.
rejection.task_transition_not_permitted: A task cannot move from {from} to {to}.
rejection.task_already_in_status: This task is already in that state.
rejection.task_concluded: This task has finished, so nothing further can be recorded against it.
rejection.task_blocked_by_predecessor: This task is waiting for the one before it.

conflict.plan_code_taken: A plan with that code already exists.
conflict.plan_already_has_a_draft: This plan already has a draft version. Publish or discard it first.
conflict.plan_version_not_draft: That version is published and cannot be changed.
conflict.task_template_code_taken: A task with that code already exists in this version.
conflict.employment_ended: That employment has ended, so there is nobody joining to onboard.
conflict.person_merged: That person's record was merged into another. Use the record it was merged into.
conflict.onboarding_race_lost: Another request created this onboarding first.
conflict.task_belongs_to_somebody_else: That task belongs to somebody else.
conflict.export_too_large: There is more here than one export can carry. Narrow it down.

label.unavailable: The API could not be reached, or it refused this caller. Nothing is shown rather than something wrong.
label.noPlan: No plan has been applied, so this onboarding has no tasks.
label.noPlansConfigured: No onboarding plans have been configured. This product ships none — what a joiner is asked to do is yours to decide.
label.boundaryEmployment: No employment fact. Status, unit, position, manager and employee number belong to Employment and Organization, read as at a date.
label.boundaryIdentity: No person's identity. Onboarding never creates a person or an employment; it references the ones the hire created.
label.boundaryDocuments: No documents. A document task records a reference; nothing here stores a file.
label.boundaryMessaging: No messaging. Onboarding raises events; Communications delivers when it can address a recipient.
label.eventLimitation: An onboarding is never started by an event alone. Reconciliation is what guarantees a joiner has one.
